name: Wellington International
address: 3400 Equestrian Club Dr, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: The showgrounds at the center of Wellington's winter season and home of the Winter Equestrian Festival. For thirteen weeks each winter, show jumpers, hunters and equitation riders from across the United States and dozens of countries compete here, and spectators can watch much of the action.
tips: The 2027 Winter Equestrian Festival runs January 6 to April 4
Saturday night grand prix events draw the biggest crowds
Plan for seasonal traffic on South Shore Blvd
about: Wellington International is the equestrian showgrounds at 3400 Equestrian Club Drive and the home of the Winter Equestrian Festival, a hunter and jumper circuit that began in 1977. The venue also runs the Annual Series horse shows and is tied to the Adequan Global Dressage Festival at Equestrian Village, adding up to more than 40 weeks of shows a year. Riders and horses come from all 50 states and more than 55 countries. Spectator events include Saturday Night Lights during WEF, group lunch tours and premium hospitality packages. The property is private, and outside food, drinks and coolers are not allowed.

name: National Polo Center
address: 3667 120th Ave S, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: The United States Polo Association's flagship venue, set on roughly 161 acres with seven tournament fields. Sunday polo during the winter season is a Wellington tradition, and the clubhouse hosts dining and private events.
tips: The 2026 to 2027 Palm Beach polo season runs December 27 to May 2
Sunday matches are the classic way to experience polo
Group seating is available for larger parties
about: The National Polo Center in Wellington is owned and run by the United States Polo Association, which bought the former International Polo Club Palm Beach in 2022 and renamed it. The club opened for the 2004 season and has six championship fields, including the stadium field. Each winter it hosts the Gauntlet of Polo from February to April, made up of the C.V. Whitney Cup, the USPA Gold Cup and the U.S. Open Polo Championship. Sunday matches on Field One are ticketed, with brunch at the Pavilion included in some tickets, and many other games during the season are free to watch.

name: Equestrian Village (Global Dressage Festival)
address: 13500 South Shore Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: The home of the Adequan Global Dressage Festival, which brings international dressage competition to Wellington each winter. Evening freestyle performances set to music are a highlight for spectators who are new to the sport.
tips: Dressage season typically runs January through March
Check the official schedule for evening freestyle nights
about: Equestrian Village, often called The Stadium, is the home of the Adequan Global Dressage Festival, a winter series of international dressage competitions in Wellington. The 2026 season ran from January 7 to March 29 and offered more than $550,000 in prize money, including FEI World Cup qualifiers. Friday Night Stars evenings feature top CDI classes under the lights, and the International Arena stands are covered. The venue is operated as part of Wellington International, which also runs the Winter Equestrian Festival.

name: Peaceful Waters Sanctuary
address: 11676 Pierson Rd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: A roughly 30 acre wetland preserve tucked into the back of Village Park, with about 1,500 feet of elevated boardwalk and a one mile trail. It is one of the best free birdwatching spots in Palm Beach County, with herons, wading birds and the occasional alligator.
tips: Free admission and parking
Enter through Village Park and follow signs to the back lot
Dogs and bikes are not allowed on the trails
about: Peaceful Waters Sanctuary is a free, 30 acre man-made wetland at the back of Village Park, run by the Village of Wellington. About 1,500 feet of raised boardwalk and a one mile walking trail loop through the marsh. Birders come for roseate spoonbills, white pelicans, herons, egrets, ibises, storks and wintering ducks, and winter is the busiest season for birds. Restrooms and picnic tables are available in the surrounding park.
hours: Daily, dawn to dusk; closed holidays

name: Village Park
address: 11700 Pierson Rd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington's largest park at about 114 acres, with athletic fields, two gymnasiums, a skate park, a playground and a walking path of roughly 2.5 miles. It is the hub for youth sports leagues across the village.
tips: Home to many youth league games on weekends
Peaceful Waters Sanctuary is at the back of the complex
about: Village Park is Wellington's largest park, covering about 114 acres on Pierson Road, and it serves as the main home for the village's youth sports leagues. It has two gymnasiums plus wrestling, cheer and multipurpose rooms, along with soccer, football and baseball fields, roller hockey rinks and pickleball courts. Outdoor features include a playground, a skate park and a walking trail of about 2.5 miles with exercise stations. Pavilions with grills, concession stands and restrooms support game days, and Peaceful Waters Sanctuary and the new Wellington Aquatics Center sit on the same grounds.

name: Wellington Environmental Preserve
address: 3491 Flying Cow Ranch Rd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: A 365 acre preserve at the Marjory Stoneman Douglas Everglades Habitat on the western edge of the village, with paved trails and a six story observation tower overlooking the Everglades landscape. Wide open and quiet, it is great for long walks and family bike rides.
tips: Bring water and sun protection, shade is limited
Climb the observation tower for the best views
Dogs are not permitted on the trails
about: The Wellington Environmental Preserve at the Marjory Stoneman Douglas Everglades Habitat opened in 2010 on the western edge of the village. It was built to filter stormwater before it flows toward the Everglades, and it doubles as a free nature park. A paved inner loop of nearly 3 miles includes boardwalk sections over the wetlands, and an outer earthen trail of about 3.7 miles is open to horseback riders. A six story open-air observation tower gives wide views of the marsh, and seven learning stations explain local ecology and water filtration. More than 200 bird species have been recorded there.
hours: Daily 8 a.m.-8 p.m.

name: Wellington Amphitheater
address: 12100 Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: The Wellington Amphitheater is the village's free outdoor stage at Town Center, 12100 Forest Hill Blvd, next to Scott's Place playground and Lake Wellington. It hosts free tribute band concerts, food truck nights, movie nights and seasonal festivals for up to about 1,500 people.
tips: Admission and parking are free for most village events
Bring lawn chairs or a blanket; seating is on the lawn
Arrive about an hour early on concert nights for parking
Do not park in the neighboring Publix lot
Call 561-753-2484 for rain-out updates
title: Wellington Amphitheater: Free Concerts, Events, Parking & Address
meta: Wellington Amphitheater at 12100 Forest Hill Blvd: free tribute concerts, food truck nights and movie nights. Parking, seating, schedule and tips.
about: The Wellington Amphitheater is a village-owned outdoor stage at the Town Center municipal complex on Forest Hill Blvd. It opened with a concert on July 3, 2010, with help from a Palm Beach County grant, and was later expanded with more lawn space as part of the Town Center improvements. The venue holds up to about 1,500 people and has a modern sound and lighting system. It hosts free concerts, food truck nights, movie nights, theater, school events and seasonal festivals.

name: Wellington Town Center and Lake Wellington
address: 12150 Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: The civic heart of the village, set along Lake Wellington. Town Center brings together the amphitheater, community center, Village Hall and Scott's Place, a popular playground designed so children of all abilities can play together.
tips: Scott's Place playground is a favorite for young kids
Walk the lakefront promenade at sunset
about: Wellington's Town Center is the village's civic campus on Forest Hill Blvd along Lake Wellington. It brings together Village Hall, the Wellington Community Center (a multi-use building of more than 28,000 square feet with rentable rooms and an open-air patio), the Wellington Amphitheater, a 9/11 memorial that includes a piece of the World Trade Center, and Scott's Place. Scott's Place is a barrier-free playground that opened in 2010, was donated by local residents in memory of their son, and was expanded in 2026 with new inclusive equipment, turf and shade. A roughly $8 million second phase of Town Center work added parking and more amphitheater lawn.
hours: Community Center: Mon-Thu 7 a.m.-9 p.m.; Fri closed; Sat 9 a.m.-6 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.-5 p.m.

name: Wellington Aquatics Center
address: 3410 120th Ave S, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington's public aquatics center at Village Park, opened in January 2026, with a 64-meter competition pool, diving boards, a zero-depth family recreation pool and Florida's first NinjaCross retractable obstacle course. Resident rates are available.
tips: NinjaCross and the high dive need a 48-inch height and a swim test
Check the village site for weather closures before you go
about: The Wellington Aquatics Center is the village's public pool complex at Village Park, which opened with a celebration on January 3, 2026. It has a full-size Olympic competition pool kept around 79 to 80 degrees, diving boards, and a zero-depth entry recreation pool kept around 83 to 85 degrees with interactive play features and shaded cabanas. It also has Florida's first NinjaCross retractable obstacle course over the water. Locker rooms, a concession stand and a multipurpose room round out the facility, and residents pay lower daily rates than non-residents.
hours: Labor Day to Memorial Day: Mon-Sat 9 a.m.-7 p.m., Sun noon-7 p.m.; Memorial Day to Labor Day: Mon-Sat 8 a.m.-8 p.m., Sun noon-8 p.m.

name: The Mall at Wellington Green
address: 10300 W Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington's regional shopping mall on State Road 7, with more than 140 stores, restaurants and entertainment spots on two levels, anchored by Macy's, Dillard's, JCPenney and City Furniture. The upper level near CMX Cinemas Wellington 10 is home to Palm Beach Improv and Copper Blues Rock Pub & Kitchen, which opened in October 2026.
tips: Holiday hours 2026: closed Thanksgiving (Nov 26); Black Friday (Nov 27) 8 a.m. to 9 p.m.; Dec 14 to 20 open 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.; Christmas Eve 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; closed Christmas Day; New Year's Eve and New Year's Day 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Department stores and big names in the directory: Macy's, Dillard's, JCPenney, City Furniture, Ashley Homestore, Apple Store, H&M, Abercrombie & Fitch, Hollister, American Eagle, Bath & Body Works, Victoria's Secret and Pandora
Places to eat inside: Chick-fil-A, California Pizza Kitchen, Cask + Shaker Craft Bar and Kitchen, Starbucks, Auntie Anne's, Cinnabon, Sbarro, Popeyes and Charley's Philly Steaks
Entertainment: CMX Cinemas Wellington 10, Palm Beach Improv, Copper Blues, Arcade Time and The Palm Beach Museum of Natural History
The full store directory and map are on the mall's website; mall office phone (561) 227-6900
Weekday mornings are the quietest time to shop
Several sit-down restaurants surround the mall
hours: Mon to Sat 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.
about: The Mall at Wellington Green is an enclosed two-level regional shopping mall at Forest Hill Boulevard and State Road 7, the largest retail center in Wellington. It was developed by Taubman Centers and opened in October 2001, and it is now managed by Spinoso Real Estate Group. The mall has about 1.27 million square feet of space and more than 170 stores, with Dillard's, JCPenney, Macy's, Ashley Furniture and City Furniture among its anchors. CMX Cinemas operates a movie theater on site, and roughly 7,600 parking spaces surround the building. Former anchors include Burdines, Lord & Taylor and Nordstrom, which closed in 2019.

name: The Village Green
address: 2877 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: A newer shopping and medical complex along State Road 7, anchored by Trader Joe's and a Cleveland Clinic facility, just east of the K-Park site where Village Landing is being built.
tips: Trader Joe's parking is busiest on weekend afternoons
about: Village Green Center is a grocery-anchored shopping center on State Road 7 (US 441) in Wellington, next to The Mall at Wellington Green. Trader Joe's is its anchor tenant, and the center has about 70,000 square feet of leasable space shared by national, regional and local businesses. It is listed by Kimco Realty, which reports the center as fully leased. Cleveland Clinic Florida operates a Wellington facility in the same State Road 7 corridor, and Wellington Green Commons, anchored by Whole Foods, sits nearby as a separate property.

name: Village Landing (coming 2028)
address: 10400 Stribling Way, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Related Ross is building Village Landing, a 71 acre walkable town center on the former K-Park land, with shops, restaurants, offices, a 180 room Hilton hotel and a central lake with a boardwalk. It is expected to open in fall 2028.
tips: Read our full guide to what is coming
about: Village Landing is a mixed-use town center that Related Ross is building on roughly 70 acres of former village-owned land known as K-Park, off State Road 7 at Stribling Way. Related Ross agreed to buy the land from Wellington for $47 million and announced in September 2026 that the purchase had closed, after village leaders approved plans that include a pedestrian-only promenade and several districts. The plan calls for about 80 shops and restaurants, roughly a third of them restaurants, plus 70,000 square feet of office space for local businesses and a 180-key residence-style hotel operated by Hilton. Construction began in 2026, and the project is scheduled to open in fall 2028.

name: Wingrove Academy (opening 2028)
address: Stribling Way, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: A new nonprofit PreK through 12 independent school being developed by ElevateED on the back portion of the K-Park site, with the first phase planned to open in August 2028.
tips: Read everything we know about the school
title: Wingrove Academy Wellington FL: Opening 2028, K-Park Campus
about: Wingrove Academy is a nonprofit, independent PreK through 12 school being developed on the western portion of Wellington's K-Park property, next to the Village Landing town center. It is being created by ElevateED, an education management organization led by founder and CEO Karen Yung, with backing tied to Related Ross. Initial enrollment for PreK through grade 8 is planned for August 2028, with the first high school class following in August 2029. The campus is designed by architect David Manfredi of Elkus Manfredi and is planned with indoor and outdoor learning spaces and sports fields, with programs in STEAM, visual and performing arts and athletics. Reports describe a site of nearly 44 acres and a $10 million scholarship fund for Wellington residents with financial need.

name: Lion Country Safari
address: 2003 Lion Country Safari Rd, Loxahatchee, FL 33470
desc: A drive-through safari park a short drive north of Wellington, where you tour animal habitats from your own car, then park for a walk-through area with rides, animal encounters and a water play zone. A classic day out for families.
tips: Arrive early on weekends to beat the line
Budget a full day if you plan to do the walk-through park
about: Lion Country Safari is a drive-through wildlife park in Loxahatchee, a short drive north of Wellington, that opened in 1967 and bills itself as the first cageless zoo in the United States. Visitors drive their own vehicles slowly along a 4-mile preserve divided into seven sections, listening to recorded narration as they pass free-roaming animals. The park covers more than 600 acres and is home to over 1,000 animals, including a group of chimpanzees that live on islands and include retirees from research and entertainment. After the drive, the Safari World walk-through area offers giraffe feeding, a petting zoo, an animal theater, mini golf, paddle boats and a restaurant.

name: Okeeheelee Park
address: 7715 Forest Hill Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33413
desc: One of Palm Beach County's largest parks, just east of Wellington on Forest Hill Blvd, with lakes, trails, a nature center, a golf course and a BMX track.
tips: The nature center is a good stop for kids
Bring bikes for the paved trails
about: Okeeheelee Park is a Palm Beach County park of more than 1,700 acres on Forest Hill Boulevard, just east of Wellington near the Florida's Turnpike interchange. The county bought the land in 1973 and opened the first phase in 1982, with the park completed in 1996. It has two lakes used for fishing, boating and water skiing, a county golf course, a BMX race track, mountain bike trails and an equestrian center with trails. The Okeeheelee Nature Center occupies about 90 acres at the north end with live animal exhibits and walking trails, and the park also has a dog park, sports fields, tennis courts, disc golf and picnic pavilions. Entry to the park grounds is free.
hours: Daily sunrise to sunset

name: South Florida Fairgrounds and Yesteryear Village
address: 9067 Southern Blvd, West Palm Beach, FL 33411
desc: Home of the South Florida Fair each winter and events year round, plus Yesteryear Village, a living history park that recreates Florida life from the late 1800s to the mid 1900s.
tips: The South Florida Fair runs each January
Check the event calendar for weekend expos and shows
about: The South Florida Fairgrounds on Southern Boulevard hosts the South Florida Fair, first held in 1912 as the Palm Beach County Fair and now held for about 17 days each January. The grounds include the South Florida Fair Expo Center, an exhibit hall of about 150,000 square feet, along with an agricultural Agriplex and other exhibit buildings used for trade shows and events year round. Yesteryear Village is a 10-acre living history park on the property with original and replica buildings from roughly 1895 to 1945, such as a schoolhouse, farm, blacksmith shop, general store and homes, where costumed interpreters describe early Florida life. The village also houses the Sally Bennett Big Band Hall of Fame Museum.
offerings: Big Band Hall of Fame Museum
hours: Yesteryear Village: Thu-Sat 10 a.m.-4 p.m.; Sun-Wed closed (varies during events)

name: Mounts Botanical Garden
address: 531 N Military Trail, West Palm Beach, FL 33415
desc: Palm Beach County's oldest and largest public garden, with themed gardens, tropical fruit trees and a striking floating walkway over water.
tips: Go in the morning when it is cooler
about: Mounts Botanical Garden is Palm Beach County's oldest and largest public garden, located on Military Trail across from Palm Beach International Airport. Plantings began after the Mounts Building opened in 1954, and the garden is run by the county's Cooperative Extension in partnership with UF/IFAS and the nonprofit Friends of Mounts Botanical Garden. Its roughly 20 acres hold more than 7,000 species of tropical and subtropical plants in themed areas such as the Butterfly Garden, Edible Garden, Florida Native Plant Garden, Rose and Fragrance Garden and Tropical Forest. Windows on the Floating World is a wetland garden with walkways over the water. Palm Beach County residents get free entry on the first Wednesday of each month, and dogs are welcome on the second Sunday.
hours: Tue-Sun 9 a.m.-4 p.m. (Nov-May), 9 a.m.-3 p.m. (Jun-Oct); Mon closed

name: Kaluz
address: 2025 Wellington Green Dr, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: An upscale New American restaurant near Wellington Green with a full bar and outdoor seating, and one of the most talked about dinner spots in the village.
about: Kaluz is a New American restaurant and cocktail bar on Wellington Green Drive, near The Mall at Wellington Green, and part of the small Kaluz group of South Florida restaurants. The menu covers steaks and chops such as prime rib and bone-in ribeye, seafood including coconut shrimp and fish dishes, salads, and shareable starters like meatballs and loaded baked potato. It serves lunch and dinner every day, with indoor dining, bar seating and an outdoor patio. The setting is more upscale than casual, and it is often used for dinners out and celebrations.
hours: Mon-Thu 11:30 a.m.-9 p.m.; Fri-Sat 11:30 a.m.-10 p.m.; Sun 11:30 a.m.-9 p.m.

name: Agliolio Fresh Pasta and Wine Bar
desc: A family owned Italian spot known for fresh pasta and a lively, busy dining room. A local go-to for date nights and family dinners alike.
address: 2803 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Agliolio is a family-run Italian restaurant founded in October 2009 by Jeff and Donna Duelfer, now led by Jeff as CEO and his daughter Stefani Eberhart as president. This State Road 7 location near Stribling Way is one of three, alongside a Wellington Plaza restaurant on Forest Hill Boulevard and one in Boynton Beach. Pasta is made by hand daily from semolina, and guests can pair about 10 pasta shapes with some 20 house sauces, or build 10-inch thin-crust pizzas. The name joins the Italian words for garlic and oil, which appear in most dishes. Gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options are offered, along with takeout, delivery and catering.
hours: Daily from 11:30 a.m. to about 10 p.m. (closed Thanksgiving and Christmas)

name: Hausmash
desc: A casual burger joint built around smashed burgers, fries and a laid-back atmosphere.
address: 10660 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 170, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Hausmash is a 1980s-themed smash burger restaurant in Wellington Green Square, opened in October 2025 by founder and CEO Diego Ucciferri. Its burgers are thin, crisp-edged smash patties of certified Angus beef on brioche buns, and fries are cooked in beef tallow. The compact menu has six burgers, six milkshakes and five styles of fries, including the Rockin' Bacon Burger, truffle and pecorino fries, and a Nutella milkshake. The retro decor and casual counter-style setup make it a quick stop for lunch or a late dinner.
hours: Sun-Thu 11:30 a.m.-10 p.m.; Fri-Sat 11:30 a.m.-11 p.m.

name: Spiro's Taverna of Wellington
desc: A Greek taverna that gave Wellington a sit-down option for gyros, grilled meats and Mediterranean classics.
address: 12020 S Shore Blvd, Suite 900, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Spiro's Taverna of Wellington is a Greek and American restaurant in the Shoppes at Chancellor on South Shore Boulevard. It opened in April 2026 as a franchise location of Spiro's Taverna, a Treasure Coast group with six other restaurants, and is the brand's first in Palm Beach County. The menu runs to more than 90 dishes, from gyros, dolmades, spanakopita, moussaka and pastitsio to burgers, a Philly cheesesteak and a tuna melt. It is open daily for lunch and dinner with a happy hour from 3 to 6 p.m., and offers pickup, delivery and Greek-style catering for events.
hours: Daily 11 a.m.-9 p.m.

name: Alacruz Grill Argentine Restaurant
desc: Argentine grill fare in a fine dining setting, a fitting cuisine for a town with deep ties to the polo world.
address: 11924 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 24, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Alacruz Grill is an Argentine steakhouse in the Publix plaza at Forest Hill Boulevard and South Shore Boulevard, centered on asado cooked over a 15-foot custom wood-fired grill. The menu features Argentine cuts such as bife de chorizo (New York strip), entraña (skirt steak), ribeye, filet mignon and short ribs, along with hand-cut beef empanadas, provoleta, burrata and octopus ceviche. Pastas include short rib ravioli, and a shared tasting platter and a full asado for groups are available, the latter with 48 hours' notice. It has a full bar with wine and cocktails, an indoor fireplace and patio seating, plus gluten-free and vegan options.
hours: Mon-Fri 5 p.m.-10 p.m.; Sat-Sun noon-11 p.m.

name: Oli's Fashion Cuisine
desc: A longtime Wellington restaurant with a wide-ranging menu and a loyal local following.
address: 10610 Forest Hill Blvd, Unit 20, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Oli's Fashion Cuisine is an American and international restaurant and bar on Forest Hill Boulevard that opened in November 2010. It was started by co-owners Executive Chef Dustin Parfitt and Juan Gando with the aim of bringing Palm Beach-style dining to the western communities. The menu spans dishes such as a veal chop, sesame-crusted tuna, grouper and flatbreads, and weekend brunch adds items like shrimp and grits and huevos rancheros. It serves lunch and dinner daily with a full bar, indoor and outdoor seating, reservations and takeout, and it has vegetarian and gluten-free options.
hours: Mon-Thu 11 a.m.-10 p.m.; Fri 11 a.m.-11 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.-11 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.-10 p.m.

name: Fujisan Asian Bistro
desc: A newer sushi and Asian bistro that quickly became a neighborhood favorite for rolls and gyoza.
address: 11924 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 33, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Fujisan Asian Bistro is a sushi bar and Asian fusion restaurant in the Forest Hill Boulevard plaza at South Shore Boulevard in Wellington. The menu combines sushi and sashimi, including specialty rolls such as a dragon roll and crispy rice with seared tuna, with kitchen dishes like gyoza, shrimp tempura, chicken fried rice, pad Thai and hot and sour soup. Larger sushi and sashimi platters for two are available, and lunch sushi deals are offered on days it opens at midday. It serves dine-in guests and offers takeout and delivery through apps.
hours: Mon-Tue 4:30-9:30 p.m.; Wed-Thu 11:30 a.m.-9:30 p.m.; Fri 11:30 a.m.-10:30 p.m.; Sat noon-10:30 p.m.; Sun noon-9:30 p.m.

name: Kura Revolving Sushi Bar
desc: Conveyor belt sushi where plates come to you, a fun pick for kids and groups.
address: 1349 S State Road 7, Bay 101, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Kura Revolving Sushi Bar at Lotis Wellington is a location of the Japanese conveyor-belt sushi chain, which held its grand opening here in April 2026. Plates travel past each booth on a two-level conveyor under ventilated lids, and an Express Belt delivers items ordered from tableside touch panels, while robots bring drinks. The menu has more than 100 items, with sushi plates at a flat $3.90 plus ramen, udon, side dishes and desserts. Returning empty plates through a table slot counts toward the Bikkura Pon prize game, which is popular with kids. Reservations can be made up to a week ahead through the Kura Sushi Rewards app or website.

name: Cooper's Hawk Winery and Restaurant
desc: Cooper's Hawk Winery and Restaurant at Lotis Wellington pairs a broad American menu with its own label wines, a Napa-style tasting room and a retail wine and gift shop. It is a go-to for date nights, birthdays and weekend brunch on State Road 7.
address: 1387 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
hours: Mon-Thu 11 a.m.-9 p.m.; Fri 11 a.m.-10 p.m.; Sat 10 a.m.-10 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.-9 p.m.
tips: Wine O'Clock happy hour runs Monday to Friday, 3 to 5:30 p.m.
Brunch and Bubbles is served Saturday and Sunday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
Reservations are recommended on weekend evenings, especially during winter season
Wine Club members get a monthly bottle and complimentary tastings
title: Cooper's Hawk Wellington: Hours, Happy Hour, Brunch & Menu
meta: Cooper's Hawk Wellington at 1387 S State Road 7: hours, weekend brunch, Wine O'Clock happy hour (Mon to Fri 3 to 5:30) and tasting room. (561) 922-9463.
about: Cooper's Hawk Winery and Restaurant at Lotis Wellington is a location of the national winery and restaurant chain, one of two in Palm Beach County, and it opened in early December. The restaurant seats about 280 guests in booths, tables, the bar and an outdoor area, with a private dining room for up to 48. Its scratch kitchen menu covers steaks, seafood, chicken, pasta, burgers and salads, with dishes such as red wine braised short ribs and crispy Brussels sprouts, plus a kids' menu, lower-calorie Life Balance choices and weekend brunch. An on-site tasting room pours the brand's own wines in flights, and a monthly Wine Club offers private-label bottles and reserved pickup parking.

name: Sicilian Oven
desc: Wood-fired pizza and Italian dishes, a reliable family dinner pick.
address: 10610 Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Sicilian Oven Wellington is part of a South Florida group of Italian restaurants with about ten locations, including Lighthouse Point, Boca Raton, Coral Springs, Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach Gardens. The kitchen is built around wood-fired pizza, served alongside a broader menu of Italian dishes. The Forest Hill Boulevard restaurant has a bar with craft cocktails and a happy hour. Guests can walk in and join a live online waitlist, order pickup or get delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats, and the restaurant also handles catering, events and a Chef for a Day experience.
hours: Mon-Sat 11:30 a.m.-10 p.m.; Sun noon-10 p.m. (closed July 4, Thanksgiving and Christmas)

name: Franco Italian Bistro
desc: An Italian bistro with a more upscale feel.
address: 10160 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 130, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Franco Italian Bistro is an Italian restaurant on Forest Hill Boulevard in Wellington that serves dinner every evening. The menu focuses on Italian and seafood dishes, and items frequently mentioned by diners include short rib, ravioli, chicken scarpariello, veal piccata and a chopped salad, along with house bread and desserts. It has a dining bar, an indoor dining room and an outdoor patio, and the dress code is casual. Reservations are taken through OpenTable.
hours: Daily 4:30 p.m.-10 p.m. (dinner)

name: Talkin' Tacos
desc: Quick-serve tacos with late hours near The Mall at Wellington Green, popular for a casual bite.
address: 10140 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 170, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Talkin' Tacos is a fast-casual Mexican chain that began as a South Florida food truck in 2020 and opened its Wellington restaurant, its first in Palm Beach County, on July 14, 2023. The shop is on Forest Hill Boulevard near The Mall at Wellington Green and is known for beef birria braised for about 12 hours, served in tacos, ramen, pizza, grilled cheese and mac and cheese. Other items include Southwest chicken and shrimp tacos, loaded nachos and street corn, with churros and drinks like horchata and mangonadas. The menu is halal, and it stays open late every night for dine-in, takeout and delivery.
hours: Daily 11 a.m.-2 a.m.

name: Tulum Mexican Cuisine
desc: A sit-down Mexican restaurant that locals have rallied around since opening.
address: 13889 Wellington Trace, Suite A14-A15, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Tulum Mexican Cuisine is a sit-down Mexican restaurant in the Wellington Marketplace plaza on Wellington Trace. The kitchen serves traditional Mexican dishes such as queso with chorizo, guacamole, quesadillas, fajitas and seafood plates, along with handcrafted cocktails from the bar. The restaurant runs a Taco Tuesday and offers Sunday brunch. A private space called the Green Room holds up to 42 guests for parties, events and meetings.

name: Keke's Breakfast Cafe
desc: Pancakes, omelets and brunch favorites. Expect a wait on weekend mornings.
address: 10120 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 190, Wellington, FL 33414
about: Keke's Breakfast Cafe is a breakfast, brunch and lunch restaurant at The Pointe at Wellington Green on Forest Hill Boulevard. Keke's is a Central Florida-based chain, and the Wellington cafe was its first location south of the county line. The breakfast menu centers on pancakes, waffles, French toast and omelets, including stuffed pancakes and options like Florida pancakes and chicken and waffles. Lunch adds paninis, sandwiches, burgers, wraps and salads. Takeout, delivery and catering can be ordered online.

hours: Mon-Sat 9 a.m.-9 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.-8 p.m.

name: Scenthound Wellington
address: 13860 Wellington Trace, Suite 37, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Dog grooming studio in the Courtyard Shops focused on routine care such as baths, nail trims, ear cleaning and teeth brushing.
about: Scenthound Wellington is a dog grooming location in the Courtyard Shops at Wellington Trace and Greenview Shores Boulevard. Scenthound is a franchise built around routine hygiene care for dogs, with a core visit that includes a bath, nail trim, ear cleaning and teeth brushing. Haircuts and blow-drying are available, and the brand offers a monthly membership for regular care. The Wellington location opened in April 2017 and is a member of the Wellington Chamber of Commerce.

name: Dog Training Elite Palm Beach County
desc: Dog training franchise serving Wellington and much of Palm Beach County, with obedience, puppy, service dog and behavior programs.
about: Dog Training Elite Palm Beach County is the local branch of the Dog Training Elite franchise and lists Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, Greenacres and Loxahatchee Groves among its service areas. Programs cover obedience training, puppy training, group classes, service dog and therapy dog training. Trainers also work on behavior problems such as anxiety and aggression, biting, fear and reactivity, separation anxiety, excessive barking, potty training and destructive chewing or digging.

name: Rood & Riddle Equine Hospital Wellington
address: 5320 South Shore Blvd, Wellington, FL 33449
desc: Full-service equine hospital on South Shore Boulevard offering surgery, advanced imaging, sport horse medicine and 24-hour care.
about: Rood & Riddle Equine Hospital Wellington is the Florida campus of the Lexington, Kentucky equine practice founded in 1982, and it has operated on South Shore Boulevard since 2017. The hospital provides surgery, internal medicine, sport horse medicine, podiatry, reproduction, regenerative medicine, ambulatory calls and laboratory work. Its diagnostic center includes CT, equine PET scanning, nuclear scintigraphy and digital radiography, along with an orthopedic surgery center. It also takes referrals from local veterinarians.
hours: Open 24 hours

name: Daniel Equine Services
desc: Mobile equine veterinary practice in Wellington focused on sport horses, with lameness work, pre-purchase exams and surgical consults.
about: Daniel Equine Services is a mobile equine veterinary practice with a Wellington office and a second location in Ocala. The practice is led by a board-certified equine surgeon and focuses on performance horses, sale horses and complex cases. Services include sports medicine, lameness diagnosis and treatment, pre-purchase exams, surgical consultations, regenerative therapies, and wellness and emergency care. The office can be reached by phone or text during weekday business hours.
hours: Mon-Fri 8:30 a.m.-5 p.m.

name: The Tackeria
address: 13501 South Shore Blvd, Suite 107, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Tack shop in the Saddle Club Shops at South Shore Boulevard and Pierson Road, in the middle of Wellington's equestrian district.
about: The Tackeria is a tack and riding equipment store in the Saddle Club Shops at the corner of South Shore Boulevard and Pierson Road, about a mile north of Lake Worth Road. The location puts it close to Wellington International and many of the barns in the area's equestrian neighborhoods. The shop serves riders and horse owners looking for tack and riding gear, and it is one of several tack stores clustered in this part of town. Call the store for current hours and product availability.

name: Tack N Rider
address: 3031 Fortune Way, Suite A9, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Tack and rider apparel shop on Fortune Way selling breeches, helmets, saddles, bridles and horse care supplies in store and online.
about: Tack N Rider is an equestrian tack and apparel shop in the Fortune Way business park in Wellington. It sells riding apparel such as breeches and helmets along with saddles, bridles, grooming tools and horse care supplies for several riding disciplines. Brands carried include Tucci, Samshield and Flex-On. The shop sells both in store and online and is open six days a week.
hours: Mon-Sat 9:30 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sun closed

name: Dressage Connection
address: 3500 Fairlane Farms Rd, Suite 10, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Dressage-focused tack shop on Fairlane Farms Road selling saddles, bridles, riding apparel and stable accessories.
about: Dressage Connection is a tack shop on Fairlane Farms Road that specializes in equipment and apparel for dressage riders. It carries saddles, bridles and other riding gear along with show and schooling apparel and stable accessories. The shop has long been involved in the local dressage show scene, sponsoring Best Turned Out awards at South Florida CDI competitions. It is open on weekdays.
hours: Mon-Fri 10 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sat-Sun closed

name: Gold Coast Feed and Supply
address: 13501 South Shore Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Horse feed, hay, bedding and supplement store at South Shore Boulevard and Pierson Road, with farm delivery during the winter season.
about: Gold Coast Feed and Supply is an equine feed store at the corner of South Shore Boulevard and Pierson Road in Wellington. It stocks feeds, supplements, hay and bedding for horses and stays open year-round. During the winter show season, roughly January through April, it offers farm deliveries. Gold Coast Feed is the official feed and bedding supplier of Wellington International and serves riders during the Winter Equestrian Festival and the Adequan Global Dressage Festival.

name: Wellington Equestrian Realty
address: 13501 S Shore Blvd, Suite 108, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Owner-run brokerage on South Shore Boulevard specializing in Wellington horse farms, equestrian homes, land and seasonal rentals.
about: Wellington Equestrian Realty is a farm and luxury home brokerage on South Shore Boulevard that has been owner-run since 2010. The team represents buyers and sellers of horse farms, equestrian properties and luxury homes, handles land sales in Wellington and Loxahatchee, and arranges seasonal residential and farm rentals. Its focus areas include Palm Beach Point, Equestrian Club, Palm Beach Polo Club, Polo West and Aero Club. Agents named on its site include Cam Scott and Chris and Rob Desino.

name: The Dutta Corporation
address: 3121 Fairlane Farms Rd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington-based equine air transport company, founded in 1988, that arranges domestic and international horse flights.
about: The Dutta Corporation is an equine air transport company founded in 1988 by Tim Dutta, with an office on Fairlane Farms Road in Wellington. It arranges international and domestic horse flights, including coast-to-coast flights within the U.S. and routes from New York, Miami and Chicago to Europe, plus regular flights to Mexico and Argentina. The company helps with pre-flight bloodwork, health papers, vaccination checks, scheduling, consolidating shipments and customs clearance, and professional grooms travel with the horses.

name: Mathnasium of Wellington
address: 10120 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 180, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Math tutoring center at The Pointe at Wellington Green offering in-center and online help for students in grades 1 through 12.
about: Mathnasium of Wellington is a math learning center in The Pointe shopping plaza on Forest Hill Blvd. It tutors students in grades 1 through 12, covering arithmetic foundations through prealgebra, geometry, algebra and precalculus, either at the center or online. New students start with a free diagnostic assessment that is used to build a personalized learning plan. The center also offers homework help during sessions and test prep for school tests, state assessments, SAT, ACT and PSAT. Memberships are billed monthly, and most students attend two to three sessions a week.
hours: Instruction Mon-Thu 2:30-7:30 p.m.; Sat 10 a.m.-1 p.m.; Fri and Sun closed

name: Kumon Math and Reading Center Wellington - South
address: 3975 Isles View Dr, Suite 103, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Local Kumon franchise center offering the Kumon after-school math and reading programs for children in Wellington.
about: Kumon Math and Reading Center Wellington - South is a franchise location of the Kumon after-school learning program, located on Isles View Drive in Wellington. Kumon centers teach math and reading through a self-paced worksheet method, with students working at the center and completing assignments at home between visits. Call or visit the center's Kumon page for class days, enrollment and current fees.

name: The UPS Store (Wellington Town Square)
address: 11924 W Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 10A, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: UPS Store at Forest Hill and South Shore handling shipping, packing, printing, mailboxes and notary service seven days a week.
about: The UPS Store at Wellington Town Square (store 2128) is at Forest Hill Blvd and South Shore Blvd, next to Publix and CVS. The franchise store ships UPS packages domestically and internationally, packs items and sells boxes and moving supplies, and also handles freight shipments. Its print center makes copies, business cards, brochures, banners, posters and blueprints. Other services include private mailboxes, notary service for documents such as wills, deeds and affidavits, passport photos, shredding, faxing and scanning. The store and its notary service are open seven days a week.
hours: Open 7 days; call for daily hours

name: SmartStop Self Storage - Wellington
address: 1341 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Self storage on State Road 7 with drive-up and climate-controlled units plus uncovered parking for cars, boats and RVs.
about: SmartStop Self Storage on State Road 7 offers storage units from 5 by 5 feet up to 10 by 30 feet, including drive-up, ground-level and climate-controlled options. The facility also has uncovered parking spaces for cars, boats and RVs, and rents space to businesses. The property is fenced and lighted, with an electric gate, video surveillance and moving carts, and the office accepts deliveries for tenants. Gate access runs from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day, and the rental office is open seven days a week.
hours: Office Mon-Fri 9:30 a.m.-6 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.-4 p.m.; Sun 10 a.m.-2 p.m. Gate access daily 6 a.m.-10 p.m.

name: Extra Space Storage (931 S State Road 7)
address: 931 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Multi-level storage facility on State Road 7 with climate-controlled, drive-up and wine storage units and an onsite manager.
about: Extra Space Storage at 931 S State Road 7 is a multi-level self storage facility with elevator access. It offers climate-controlled indoor units and drive-up units in sizes from small lockers up to 20 by 25 feet, plus small climate-controlled wine storage units. The property has a security gate, cameras, keyless unit access and an onsite manager. Customers can rent and pay online, and the office sells moving and packing supplies. Confirm gate access hours with the office before visiting.
hours: Office Mon-Fri 9:30 a.m.-6 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.-5:30 p.m.

name: Palm Luxe Cleaners
address: 4360 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33449
desc: South Wellington dry cleaner with free pickup and delivery, wash and fold, alterations and equine laundering.
about: Palm Luxe Cleaners, formerly Go Green Dry Cleaners of Wellington, is a dry cleaner and laundry on State Road 7 in the 33449 area of Wellington. It offers dry cleaning, laundry and wash and fold service, with free pickup and delivery and rush service. The shop also handles alterations and repairs, household items such as bedding and curtains, leather and suede, shoe repair and wedding gown preservation. Reflecting the local horse community, it offers equine laundering along with commercial laundry service.

name: Bordeaux Spillane & Zahul CPAs PA
address: 12788 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 2005, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington CPA firm on Forest Hill Blvd handling individual and business taxes, bookkeeping, payroll and IRS representation.
about: Bordeaux Spillane & Zahul CPAs PA is a certified public accounting firm with an office on Forest Hill Blvd in Wellington. The firm prepares individual and business tax returns and provides bookkeeping and business accounting, payroll services and financial consulting. It also represents clients in IRS audits and appeals. The practice serves both households and small businesses in Wellington and the surrounding western communities. Call the office to set up an appointment.

name: David Berns CPA
address: 12773 Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: CPA practice in Wellington offering tax preparation and planning, bookkeeping, payroll taxes and IRS representation by appointment.
about: David Berns CPA is an accounting and tax practice on Forest Hill Blvd in Wellington, run by CPA David Berns, whom clients work with directly. Services include individual and business tax preparation and planning, new business formation, bookkeeping and write-up work, and payroll tax preparation. The practice also represents clients before the IRS and sends tax due date reminders. Visits are by appointment on weekdays, and the office entrance is wheelchair accessible.
hours: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sat-Sun closed

name: South Shore Title, Inc.
address: 12798 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 105B, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Wellington title company on Forest Hill Blvd that handles title work and real estate closings.
about: South Shore Title, Inc. is a title company with an office on Forest Hill Blvd in Wellington. It handles title work and real estate closings for property sales and purchases in Wellington and the surrounding western communities. Buyers, sellers and real estate agents use the office to coordinate closing files and closing appointments. The office is open on weekdays during regular business hours.
hours: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-5 p.m.; Sat-Sun closed

name: The Goddard School of Wellington
address: 2665 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Franchise preschool on State Road 7 enrolling infants through pre-K, with a state pre-K program and summer camp.
about: The Goddard School of Wellington is a franchise early childhood school on State Road 7. It cares for children from 6 weeks old through pre-K, with infant, toddler, twos, preschool and pre-K classrooms, and it also offers a state pre-K program and summer camp. Classrooms follow Goddard's inquiry-based Wonder of Learning curriculum, and the school lists American Sign Language and physical fitness among its activities. The school is owned by Mauricio and Anita Chmelnik, who also run The Goddard School of Miramar.
hours: Mon-Fri 7 a.m.-6 p.m.

name: Bright Horizons at Wellington
address: 3220 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33449
desc: Licensed child care center on State Road 7 for infants through age 13, with preschool, pre-K and school-age programs.
about: Bright Horizons at Wellington is a licensed child care center on State Road 7 in the 33449 area of Wellington. It serves children from infancy through age 13, with infant, toddler, preschool and kindergarten prep classrooms, a school-age program and a summer program. The center is licensed for up to 228 children and holds APPLE accreditation through the Florida Association for Child Care Management. Programs use the Bright Horizons Discovery Driven Learning approach, and full-time and part-time schedules are offered.
hours: Mon-Fri 7:30 a.m.-6 p.m.

name: Prodigy Early Learning at Wellington
address: 5415 Morning Mist Way, Wellington, FL 33449
desc: Licensed early learning center in south Wellington for infants through VPK, with a Montessori and Reggio-inspired approach.
about: Prodigy Early Learning at Wellington is a licensed child care center in the 33449 area of south Wellington. It enrolls infants from 6 weeks, toddlers, preschoolers and Voluntary Pre-K students, and runs a summer camp for children ages 5 to 8. Teaching draws on Montessori, Reggio Emilia and Creative Curriculum approaches. The center holds APPLE accreditation, provides meals and outdoor play space, and accepts subsidies and vouchers.
hours: Mon-Fri 7 a.m.-5:30 p.m.

name: O2B Kids Wellington
address: 111 Professional Way, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Play-based child care and preschool center in Wellington with VPK, after-school care and summer camp.
about: O2B Kids Wellington is a child care center and preschool on Professional Way in Wellington, operated under the O2B Kids name. It serves infants through children around age 5 with a play-based developmental approach, and offers Voluntary Pre-K in half-day and extended-day formats. Families can choose full-time or part-time schedules, and the center also runs after-school care and summer camp. Meals are provided.
offerings: VPK half day and extended day

name: St. David's-in-the-Pines Episcopal School
address: 465 Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Small Episcopal church school in Wellington serving pre-K through the early elementary grades, including VPK.
about: St. David's-in-the-Pines Episcopal School is a small private Christian school affiliated with St. David's-in-the-Pines Episcopal Church, on Forest Hill Blvd. It serves young children in pre-K and the early elementary grades, and offers a Voluntary Pre-K program. Federal data reported enrollment of about 84 students in 2022. Families describe school traditions such as field day, a trike-a-thon for St. Jude and an end-of-year carnival.

name: Wellington Collegiate Academy
address: 12794 Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 14B, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Small nonsectarian private school on Forest Hill Blvd serving kindergarten through 8th grade.
about: Wellington Collegiate Academy is a small, nonsectarian private school on Forest Hill Blvd in Wellington serving students in kindergarten through 8th grade. Federal private school survey data for 2021-22 listed about 90 students and 10 full-time-equivalent teachers, a ratio of roughly 9 students per teacher. The school runs a 180-day calendar with a seven-hour school day. It is coeducational and enrolls elementary and middle school students.

name: Whole Foods Market
address: 2635 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Natural and organic grocery store on State Road 7 with a hot and salad bar, in-house bakery, beer and wine, and an Amazon returns counter.
about: Whole Foods Market's Wellington store anchors the Wellington Green Commons shopping center on State Road 7. Along with natural and organic groceries, the store has a hot bar and salad bar with keto and paleo-friendly options, breads baked in-house, ready-made and custom cakes, and a cheese department with a certified cheese professional. Shoppers will also find beer and wine, custom floral arrangements and gift baskets, a Genji Sushi counter and cafe seating. Prime members can order delivery or pickup, and the store has an Amazon counter for package pickup and returns.
hours: Daily 8 a.m.-10 p.m.

name: ALDI
address: 15439 Southern Blvd, Loxahatchee Groves, FL 33470
desc: Discount grocery store on Southern Boulevard in Loxahatchee Groves, a short drive north of Wellington and west of Royal Palm Beach.
about: This ALDI is on Southern Boulevard in Loxahatchee Groves and is one of the closest ALDI stores for Wellington residents. ALDI is a discount supermarket chain that keeps prices low by stocking mostly its own store brands in a smaller-format store. Shoppers can expect produce, meat, dairy, bakery items, pantry staples, frozen foods and rotating weekly specials. Check the ALDI website for current store hours before visiting.

name: Wellington Town Square
address: 11924 W Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Publix and CVS-anchored shopping center on Forest Hill Boulevard with restaurants, a nail salon and everyday services.
about: Wellington Town Square is a neighborhood shopping center on West Forest Hill Boulevard, owned and managed by Regency Centers. The center has about 108,000 square feet of retail space and is anchored by Publix and CVS. Restaurants in the plaza include Rivales Taqueria and Craft Bar and Fujisan Asian Bistro, and California Nails is among its shops. It is a convenient stop for groceries, prescriptions and a quick meal in central Wellington.

name: Courtyard Shops at Wellington
address: 13860 Wellington Trace, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Publix-anchored neighborhood shopping center on Wellington Trace with restaurants, a gym, a nail salon and other local shops.
about: Courtyard Shops at Wellington is a grocery-anchored neighborhood shopping center on Wellington Trace near Greenview Shores Boulevard. Built in 1990, the center has roughly 129,000 square feet of space on an 18-acre site, with Publix as its anchor. Tenants have included restaurants, a frozen custard shop, a kickboxing gym, a nail salon and service businesses. Federal Realty Investment Trust sold the center in 2015 for $52.8 million.

name: Kids Empire Wellington
address: 10300 W Forest Hill Blvd, Suite 268, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Indoor playground at The Mall at Wellington Green with mazes, slides, ball pits and a toddler zone, plus birthday party packages.
about: Kids Empire Wellington is an indoor playground inside The Mall at Wellington Green. The play area is built for children ages 1 to 12 and includes a multi-level maze, winding slides, jungle gym passages, ball pits, obstacle routes, a dance floor and a separate toddler zone for ages 1 to 3. Admission is good for the whole day with same-day re-entry, and up to two adults come in free with each paying child. Socks and a signed waiver are required, and the park takes card payments only. Party packages and group outings for 10 or more kids are available.

name: Wellington Dog Park at Greenbriar Park
address: 2975 Greenbriar Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Village-run off-leash dog park in Greenbriar Park with separate fenced areas for large, medium and small dogs.
about: The Wellington Dog Park sits inside Greenbriar Park near Greenbriar Boulevard and Aero Club Drive and is run by the Village of Wellington Parks and Recreation department. The roughly 6.5-acre park is split into three fenced off-leash sections for large, medium and small dogs. Amenities include water fountains for dogs and people, pet wash and waste stations, restrooms, walking paths and shaded pavilions. Dogs must be licensed, vaccinated and at least four months old, and visitors with a dog must be 16 or older and carry a leash. The park closes Thursday mornings for cleaning.
hours: Daily dawn to dusk; Thu closed until 3 p.m. for cleaning

name: Total Wine & More
address: 960 S State Road 7, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Large wine, beer and spirits store in the Shoppes at Isla Verde on State Road 7, with weekend tastings, a cigar humidor and online ordering.
about: Total Wine & More's Wellington store is in the Shoppes at Isla Verde on State Road 7. The store carries a wide range of wine, spirits and beer, and it has a walk-in cigar humidor. An in-store sampling station pours wine, spirits, beer and cocktails on Thursday and Friday afternoons and Saturdays. Customers can order online for in-store pickup or check whether delivery is available to their address, and a free loyalty program earns points toward rewards.
hours: Mon-Thu 9 a.m.-10 p.m.; Fri-Sat 9 a.m.-11 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.-10 p.m.

name: Star Liquors
address: 10650 W Forest Hill Blvd, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Family-owned liquor and wine store in Wellington Green Square on Forest Hill Boulevard, next to the newer Publix near the mall.
about: Star Liquors is a family-owned wine and liquor store in Wellington Green Square on West Forest Hill Boulevard, near The Mall at Wellington Green. The owners opened this Wellington location when a space became available next to the new Publix in the plaza, and they marked the opening with a grand opening celebration that included tastings from regional distributors. The store sells wine, spirits and beer for everyday shopping and parties.

name: Wellington Florist
address: 13889 Wellington Trace, Suite A12, Wellington, FL 33414
desc: Flower shop on Wellington Trace serving the Palm Beaches since 1991, with bouquets, plants and same-day delivery in Palm Beach County.
about: Wellington Florist is a flower shop on Wellington Trace that has served Wellington and the Palm Beaches since 1991. The shop designs floral, plant and orchid arrangements and mixed bouquets using flowers shipped directly from growers, and it offers same-day delivery throughout Palm Beach County. Walk-in customers can choose from a cooler stocked with fresh flowers. The shop also handles event work, including floral decor, balloons, draping and lighting for parties and weddings.
offerings: Same-day delivery in Palm Beach County

name: Lowe's Home Improvement
address: 103 S State Road 7, Royal Palm Beach, FL 33411
desc: Home improvement store with a garden center on State Road 7 in Royal Palm Beach, just north of Wellington, offering installation and truck rental.
about: The Lowe's in Royal Palm Beach sits on State Road 7 a short drive north of Wellington. The store sells building supplies, tools, appliances, plumbing and electrical supplies, and home decor, and it has a garden center for plants, soil and outdoor living. Lowe's arranges installation for flooring, windows, fencing, cabinets, HVAC and other projects, and offers truck delivery, truck rental and dumpster rental. Online orders can be picked up in store or curbside, and contractors can use the separate Pro desk.
hours: Mon-Sat 6 a.m.-10 p.m.; Sun 7 a.m.-8 p.m.

name: Greenacres Bowl
address: 6126 Lake Worth Rd, Greenacres, FL 33463
desc: Bowling center on Lake Worth Road in Greenacres with open bowling, youth and adult leagues, an arcade, billiards and birthday parties.
about: Greenacres Bowl is a bowling center on Lake Worth Road in Greenacres, east of Wellington. It offers open bowling for families and groups, along with youth and adult leagues for a range of skill levels. The center has an arcade and billiards room, a kitchen serving pizza and snacks, and an on-site pro shop for balls and equipment. Birthday parties and group events can be booked.

name: Village Golf Club
address: 122 Country Club Dr, Royal Palm Beach, FL 33411
desc: Public 18-hole, par-72 golf course in Royal Palm Beach. Sold to GL Homes in November 2026; the club says golf operations will wind down with an anticipated final day of Dec. 6, 2026.
about: Village Golf Club is a public 18-hole, par-72 course in Royal Palm Beach, a short drive north of Wellington. Designed by Mark Mahannah, the course plays to about 6,900 yards from the back tees. Practice facilities include a driving range, a chipping area and a putting green, and a teaching pro offers lessons. Carts and rental clubs are available, and the clubhouse has a banquet hall, bar and catering for events. Tee times can be booked online.
